# Prompt archive, henryk-urodziny-2026

The prompts that generated the outpainting and image-to-video media for the henryk-urodziny-2026 set, copied verbatim from the production record so they survive the `tmp/` folder. Archived 2026-10-27.

| File | Contents | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `outpainting-flux3-klein.md` | FLUX 3 Klein outpainting prompts | `.agents/skills/image-outpainting/references/extender-recipe.md` |
| `image-to-video-h3.md` | ten MiniMax H3 production prompts | `data/processed/henryk-urodziny-2026/minimax-h3-10s/<stem>.md` |
| `image-to-video-ltx25.md` | eight LTX-2.5 prompts and negative extras | `tmp/workflows/ltx25-preview/render-settings.json`, `tmp/workflows/ltx25-preview/prompts/user/<stem>.json`, `tmp/workflows/ltx25-preview/prompts/<stem>-ltx.json` |
